compendium.summary: Create or maintain Skeletons/Zombies; Bonus Action commands and 24-hour upkeep.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
tactics: Persistent minions convert earlier resources into later actions, but control must be renewed. Track each group's control expiry and reserve the required maintenance slots.
Use shared orders and quick group resolution. Corpse availability, equipment, damage resistance and the campaign's social consequences are part of the cost.
Magic Stone is an optional party-synergy idea only with a legal supplier and a resolved command/attack sequence. Do not assume the Wizard learns that cantrip from Animate Dead.
